verdict.rationale: Check's own Onboard Component collects bank account information, sets up withholdings, and handles signing tax forms, which covers the W-4 and bank-details parts of the story. It is an embeddable React component that a platform builds into its own app, not a flow an ops user can directly send to a new hire. Missing for 10: any evidence of I-9 collection or verification, a documented way to send or invite a new hire to a self-serve flow before their start date, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
